findings.text: The landing fragment states the base recheck shows 'the same three time out too', but the log it cites (logs/gate-divergence-base-recheck.log) records 2 failed, 4 passed: test_diverged_tree_is_refused_with_an_error passed on the base arm, so only two of the three added failures are shown load-driven and the third is un-reproduced at base.

The three added failures (head 3 vs base 0 on the divergence file) are each a pytest-timeout at subprocess.run and reach no assertion about the routed code, so done_when's 'no added failures' is not cleanly demonstrated: the gate ran at load average near 61 and the same timeouts recur on the base arm for two of the three, but the word 'no added failures' overstates the arm delta of three.

The module docstring cites `maybe_preserve_domain`, a function that does not exist; the banned selector the tuple checks is `maybe_promote_domain` (domain_ranking.py:32), so the comment names a non-existent anchor.
